integrity: Two independently structured methods: forward parallel activation and reverse inactive four-core peeling; full state and edge certificate attached. No independent external mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite theorem for the Shrikhande and 4-by-4 rook graphs at uniform threshold three. Four-seed cardinality for the rook graph is prior-covered by Bidgoli et al. The orbit and exchange-geometry comparison is supported by finite exhaustive programs; potential unindexed exact tables remain an originality risk. No general strongly regular graph result claimed.
title: Optimal threshold-three activation and exchange geometry of two strongly regular graphs
